# PlayerLegs

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

Unity's GenericPlayer legs: the body floats at `height` over the ground, walks and jumps with forces.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `height` | `float` | eyes over the ground, m (1.8; VRBody sets it from the head) |
| `leg_force` | `float` | cap of the stand and jump gain x speed error (1000) |
| `stand_force` | `float` | stand gain (1000) |
| `stand_speed` | `float` | m/s asked per half metre under the height (0.5) |
| `jump_force` | `float` | jump gain (500) |
| `jump_speed` | `float` | m/s (5) |
| `walk_force` | `float` | walk gain (500) |
| `walk_speed` | `float` | m/s (2) |
| `sprint_speed` | `float` | m/s with the run button (4) |
| `air_walk` | `float` | part of the walk force left off the ground (0) |
| `reach` | `float` | m under the feet the ground is looked for (0.2) |
| `limp` | `bool` | no stand, walk or jump (set while riding) |
| `jump_locked` | `bool` | the jump press did something else: no jump until the button is let go |
| `standing` | `bool` | written: the ray found ground |
| `walking` | `bool` | written: standing and asked to move |
| `ground_distance` | `float` | written: eyes to the ground, when standing |
| `ground` | `entt::entity` | written: the entity stood on, null when it is no RigidBody entity |
| `ground_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | written: velocity of the ground point when it is not static |
| `applied_force` | `glm::vec3` | written: this step's leg forces (N), carried to the hands by VRHands |
| `group` | `uint32_t` | written: the player's collision group in PlayerCollision, 0 before the first step with a body |

## Notes

Needs a dynamic RigidBody with lock_rotation whose Transform is the eyes, an input component and a PlayerView. Forces are Unity's: (gain x speed error) x mass / 10. `group` is the key every other player system uses to find the player's bodies.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Grab, Hold, VRHands. Written by: Mounting, PlayerLegs, PlayerSpawn, VRBody. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Grab](../systems/Grab.md) | system | Host | **read** | grab, regroup (helper groupOf) | the player's collision group; no grab before the legs gave one |
| [Hold](../systems/Hold.md) | system | Host | **read** | pick (helper groupOf) | the player's collision group |
| [Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick, mount, dismount | group read; limp and jump_locked set on getting on and off |
| [PlayerLegs](../systems/PlayerLegs.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick, step | tuning and `limp` / `jump_locked` read; standing, walking, ground_distance, ground, ground_velocity, applied_force, group written; jump_locked cleared when jump is let go |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makers) | default legs |
| [VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md) | system | Host | **write** | tick | `height` = max(standing_height + head.y - 1.8, 0.3) |
| [VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md) | system | Host | **read** | step | of the hand's player: group, applied_force |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Grab](../systems/Grab.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit (disconnected in finish): the grips of a destroyed hand or object are taken off without a throw.
  - At each physics step: `CollideShape` of the hand's shape (max separation `touch`), `FixedConstraint` (priority 1000, 40 velocity / 8 position steps) added at the deepest contact; removed on release, teleport, finish.
  - On a throw: `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of the released body.
  - Sets and clears collision groups of grabbed bodies.
- **[Hold](../systems/Hold.md)**
  - Narrow phase ray cast of `reach` along the view on a press of interact.
  - Sets the collision group of the held body; clears it and, on a throw, sets its linear velocity when it is dropped.
  - Adds and removes BodyDrive components (BodyDrives makes the constraint).
- **[Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md)**
  - `CollideShape` of the player's capsule, at its place and 0.6 m lower, with max separation `reach`, on a press of jump when not riding.
  - Sets the collision group of the ridden animal's collider; clears it 0.6 s after getting off.
  - On a jump off: `SetLinearVelocity` of the player (the saddle's velocity plus `hop` m/s to the animal's left and 1 m/s up).
- **[PlayerLegs](../systems/PlayerLegs.md)**
  - At each 60 Hz physics step (FixedSteps.before): a narrow phase ray cast per player, `AddForce` of the stand, walk and jump forces, `ActivateBody`.
  - Sets the collision group of the player's body once (`SetCollisionGroup`).
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md)**
  - Teleports the player's Jolt body by the head's motion each frame (`BodyInterface::SetPosition`, activated).
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
